posts.title: Genrules all the way down
posts.description: I remember having a chat with @siggisim, BuildBuddy co-founder, that what made Bazel special at Google was not necessarily its technological-chops but rather Google’s monorepo (/google3/) and their strict requirement that all third-party software be built and managed within that monorepo by Bazel.

posts.title: Build systems à la trace
posts.description: As a build systems enthusiast, Build Systems à la Carte is one of my favourite papers. It defines a way to think about build systems that is both precise and surprisingly practical.
